name: B10-0424/2026 – § 13 – Am 4
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 13. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to strengthen controls relating to the issuance, renewal, withdrawal and revocation of visas, residence permits and mobility authorisations where individuals, speakers, association representatives, preachers, academics or project partners are linked to Islamist networks, organisations promoting radicalisation, antisemitism, separatism, terrorism or entities subject to restrictive measures;
